description: Land Title Settlement Department - Wewagedara, Diwulapitiya D/S Division, Gampaha District   - Cad. Map No. 510005
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed information about land ownership, extent, encumbrances, and property boundaries. The content focuses entirely on land registration and property rights without any government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other non-land related administrative matters.
